dogecoin.text: @DOGE Culture: DOGE’s Shiba Inu vibe nods to Dogecoin, Musk’s pet meme. Site flaunts it—‘Doing God’s Work’ with a wink. A troll move turned policy!
Origin: 2024, Musk tells Trump to slash $2T from fed budget. At Madison Square Garden, he pitches killing agencies & regs. An X user suggests ‘DOGE’—Musk loves it, ties it to Dogecoin meme!
